## Calculating costs
### Patch-based image tokenization
```
original_patch_count = ceil(width/32)×ceil(height/32)
```

### Tile-based image tokenization
#### GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4o-mini, CUA, and o-series (except o4-mini)
Any image with `"detail": "low"` costs a set, base number of tokens.

web.description:
## Image token estimate
**Low** uses 85 tokens per image.

- 85 + 170 × 4 = 765 tokens per image.

## What does 10,000 tokens look like?
| Scale | ≈ 10,000 tokens |
|-|-|
| Images (vision) | A **1024 × 1024** photo: `detail:"low"` ≈ **85 tokens** · `detail:"high"` ≈ **765 tokens** (OpenAI-style tiling). Crop, resize, or use caption + URL to stay lean — use the [estimator above](https://www.spoold.com/tools/vision-tokens#vision-tokens-tool) for your exact pixels. |

## Providers & formulas
- **OpenAI (GPT-4o / GPT-4–class vision)** — For **high** detail: fit inside a 2048² box, scale shortest side to ~768px, count 512×512 tiles, then `85 + 170 × tiles` per image. **Low** uses a fixed **85** tokens per image.
